rows.commentary: 6.2: Chigurupati Venkata finds a whisper of inward swing, allowing Usman Khan to cushion it gently through the leg side for a couple.
6.3: Disaster for the bowler as Chigurupati Venkata oversteps, handing Usman Khan a free hit after a simple nudge to mid-wicket.
6.3: Usman Khan clears the infield with absolute disdain, pulling a flat maximum over deep square leg to bring up Pakistan's fifty.
6.4: Chigurupati Venkata tests the length outside off, and Usman Khan dabs it toward short cover before scampering through for a single.
6.5: Chigurupati Venkata angles a back-of-a-length delivery into the channel, leaving Hayam Khan swinging through emptiness as it nips back sharply.
6.6: Hayam Khan lofts a full delivery cleanly over wide mid-off, punctuating a fifteen-run over that surges Pakistan to fifty-six.
7.1: Manal Chauhan drops it full on the pads, and Usman Khan clips it straight toward the mid-wicket fielder.
7.2: Usman Khan works Manal Chauhan away through square leg to rotate the strike with a comfortable single.
7.3: Manal Chauhan offers good flight around off, and Hayam Khan meets it solidly in defense.
7.4: Hayam Khan skips down the track to meet the delivery, driving it firmly toward deep mid-off.
7.5: Usman Khan reads the length early, camping back to carve Manal Chauhan through point for a crisp boundary.
7.6: Manal Chauhan pulls his length back slightly, inducing a straightforward return driven firmly back to the bowler's hands by Usman Khan.
8.1: Kavya Patel extracts the vital breakthrough as Hayam Khan chases a wide delivery, feathers an outside edge through to Anvay Dravid, and departs after a brisk twenty-one.
8.2: Kavya Patel immediately tests the incoming Abdul Qadir with a probing length ball outside off that beats the defensive prod on the outside edge.
8.3: Abdul Qadir opens his account in emphatic fashion, launching a length delivery from Kavya Patel over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
8.4: Kavya Patel drags the length back, inviting Abdul Qadir to comfortably bunt the ball straight down underneath his eyes.
22.6: Manal Chauhan floats it slower and fuller, allowing Abdul Qadir to mistime a drive toward long-on for a single.
23.1: Yashbardhan Chauhan fires a flatter delivery onto the stumps, prompting Abdul Qadir to rock back and cut straight to cover-point.
23.2: Yashbardhan Chauhan drops it short on the stumps, and Abdul Qadir clears his front leg to pull it completely out of the ground onto the road before celebrating with his partner.
23.3: Yashbardhan Chauhan induces a flat aerial shot just over long-on where the leaping fielder horribly misjudges the flight and palms it straight through his hands.
23.4: Yashbardhan Chauhan beats a hard-swinging Abdul Qadir all ends up with nothing connected.
23.5: Yashbardhan Chauhan serves up a very full delivery, driven cleanly by Abdul Qadir to long-off for a single.
23.6: Yashbardhan Chauhan pitches it full on the stumps, and Usman Khan knocks it down to long-on to rotate the strike.
Abdul Qadir goes back-to-back with consecutive sixes, charging to 79 off just 51 balls and keeping the scoreboard ticking!
24.1: Arjun Rajput pushes a quicker one on the off stump, catching Usman Khan's inner half for a defensive prod toward square leg as Abdul wisely refuses the run.
24.2: Arjun Rajput darts this through quicker, and Usman Khan flashes a cut straight to point.
24.3: Arjun Rajput drops short, allowing Usman Khan to rock back and pull it authoritatively over mid-wicket for a boundary.
24.4: Arjun Rajput delivers it full and straight into the stumps, pushed away towards mid-wicket.
24.5: Arjun Rajput fires this one in low and fast, forcing Usman Khan to scramble his bat down just in time.
24.6: Arjun Rajput delivers full on the stumps, and Usman Khan tucks it away toward backward square leg using the inner edge.
25.1: Yashbardhan Chauhan sends down a fullish length, prompting Usman Khan to bunt the ball solidly into the off-side.
25.2: Yashbardhan Chauhan darts through a quicker delivery, which Usman Khan drives firmly back to the left of the bowler.
25.3: Yashbardhan Chauhan slides one through, and Usman Khan rocks back to punch it away towards deep cover for a single.
25.4: Yashbardhan Chauhan fires a flatter delivery onto the stumps, allowing Abdul Qadir to turn it into the on-side.
25.5: Yashbardhan Chauhan loops this one up, and Usman Khan rotates the strike comfortably down to long-on.
38.1: Kavya Patel drops it short outside off, allowing Ahmed Hussain to steer it down to third man for a comfortable single.
38.2: Kavya Patel offers width outside off, and Farhan Yousaf slaps it firmly through the off-side to rotate the strike.
38.3: Kavya Patel floats this full delivery just outside off, allowing Ahmed Hussain to knock it comfortably down to long-off for a single.
38.4: Kavya Patel digs it slightly short on leg, and Farhan Yousaf tucks it backward of square leg to hustle back for two.
38.5: Kavya Patel rolls his fingers across this good length slower ball, but Farhan Yousaf reads the variation early, dropping low to pull it with authority over mid-wicket for four.
38.6: Kavya Patel misses his mark with a full toss to finish the over, easily driven by the batter to long-on for a single.
39.1: Aryan Savsani drops one slightly short outside off, and Farhan Yousaf cuts it sharply towards backward point.
39.2: Aryan Savsani watches Farhan Yousaf dance down the track and smoke a towering six over long-on, pushing his score into the forties to earn a celebratory fist bump.
39.3: Aryan Savsani serves up a fuller length outside off, and Farhan Yousaf drives it cleanly through the cover region for a brisk couple.
39.4: Aryan Savsani keeps it tight, and Farhan Yousaf clips the delivery into the mid-wicket pocket to collect a single.
39.5: Aryan Savsani angles one well wide of the off-stump, and Ahmed Hussain watches it pass safely through to the keeper.
39.5: Aryan Savsani gets punished slightly as Ahmed Hussain clips this delivery through square leg to pick up a single.
39.6: Aryan Savsani tests Farhan Yousaf who clears his stance and lofts the ball toward deep cover, where the fielder charges forward and dives in vain as it drops safely ahead.
40.1: Arjun Rajput targets the channel outside off with a full delivery, and Farhan Yousaf fishes tentatively outside his crease, entirely flummoxed as it zips past the edge.
40.2: Arjun Rajput keeps it outside off, allowing Farhan Yousaf to nudge it straight down the ground toward long-on for a comfortable single.
40.3: Arjun Rajput fires a full, straight delivery onto off stump, which Ahmed Hussain simply dead-bats straight back into the waiting hands of the bowler.
40.4: Arjun Rajput digs it in short, and Ahmed Hussain immediately transfers his weight backward to whip the pull shot firmly through the mid-wicket pocket.
40.5: Arjun Rajput forces Farhan Yousaf to crouch low inside his crease, where an awkward under-edge dribbles down off the pads toward the keeper.
41.4: Mohammad Sayyam drops it on a length around off, and Mohit Ulva steps firmly behind it to defend.
41.5: Mohammad Sayyam tests him with a skidding delivery just short of a length, leaving Mohit Ulva swinging through empty air as the ball ducks underneath the bat.
41.6: Mohammad Sayyam pushes it a fraction fuller outside off, driven straight to long-off where the run is flatly refused.
42.1: Ali Raza angles a shortish delivery outside off, and Manal Chauhan pats it softly to the keeper's left to collect a single.
42.2: Ali Raza fires in a dipping yorker that Mohit Ulva jams toward mid-wicket, racing across for a perilous single that a direct hit would have punished.
42.3: Ali Raza drifts one down the leg side past the shuffling batsman, leaving the umpire unmoved and the batsman frustrated.
42.4: Ali Raza drops it back outside off, and Manal Chauhan guides the delivery down to third man to collect a single.
42.5: Ali Raza drops it short, and Mohit Ulva reads the length instantly to bludgeon a ferocious pull over mid-wicket for four.
42.6: Ali Raza punctuates the over with a sharp bumper, forcing Mohit Ulva to duck underneath the rising leather.
43.1: Mohammad Sayyam offers width back of a length, and Manal Chauhan uses lightning wrists to launch it cleanly over deep extra cover for six.
43.2: Mohammad Sayyam pitches fuller around off, and Manal Chauhan pushes firmly toward extra cover.
43.3: Mohammad Sayyam digs it back of a length around middle and leg, and Mohit Ulva drags it down to long-on to rotate the strike.
43.4: Mohammad Sayyam delivers short outside off, allowing Manal Chauhan to stand tall and dispatch it cleanly over the infield for a maximum.
43.5: Mohammad Sayyam pitches fuller around off, and Manal Chauhan nudges it towards cover to pinch a rapid single.
43.6: Mohammad Sayyam serves it full and wide, inviting Mohit Ulva to slice a boundary past the scrambling third-man fielder.
44.1: Rizwanullah offers it up full and wide of off stump, inviting the drive from Manal Chauhan who flashes hard at the delivery and connects with nothing but thin air.
44.2: Rizwanullah tests back of a length outside off, prompting a disjointed slap from Manal Chauhan that finds long-off for one.
44.3: Rizwanullah offers width on the shorter side, enabling Mohit Ulva to flat-bat a fierce boundary over the inner ring at mid-off.
44.4: Rizwanullah attacks the stumps with a full delivery, pushed firmly down the ground for a single.
48.2: Mohammad Sayyam delivers full outside off, and Mohit Ulva clears his front leg to launch it powerfully over deep extra cover for a maximum.
48.3: Mohammad Sayyam attacks the stumps from round the wicket, and Mohit Ulva safely drills the full delivery down to long-on for a single.
48.4: Mohammad Sayyam goes full from round the wicket, squaring up Chigurupati Venkata whose outside edge flies past the vacant slip region for a boundary.
48.5: Mohammad Sayyam angles in a full delivery that Chigurupati Venkata pushes toward cover off a leading edge, scrambling through for a tight single.
48.6: Mohammad Sayyam fires in a fullish delivery, and Mohit Ulva meets it firmly to drive the ball down to long-on.
49.1: Ahmed Hussain spins a googly past Mohit Ulva's ambitious slog, but the batter swiftly drags his back foot inside the crease before the bails are removed.
49.2: Ahmed Hussain spots Mohit Ulva advancing and fires a wide delivery well outside off, which the batter wisely leaves alone.
49.2: Ahmed Hussain drops slightly short outside off, allowing Mohit Ulva room to free his arms and carve a single through point.
49.3: Ahmed Hussain tosses up a googly outside off that Chigurupati Venkata inside-edges onto his pad, scrambling home safely with a dive after an unsuccessful shy at the stumps.
49.4: Ahmed Hussain floats one up as Mohit Ulva charges down the track, drilling the delivery straight to long-off for a comfortable single.
49.5: Ahmed Hussain serves up a tossed-up delivery, and Chigurupati Venkata miscues his lofted stroke out to long-on to rotate the strike.
49.6: Ahmed Hussain delivers a flatter ball on the shorter side, which Mohit Ulva dances down the track to smash past wide long-off for the winning boundary amid joyous pitch invasions.

summary.text: India U19 won by 1 wkt. PAKU19 made 337-9, Usman Khan top-scoring with 107 off 111 balls; Kavya Patel took 4 for 68. INDU19 made 339-9, Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani (c) top-scoring with 80 off 101 balls; Rizwanullah took 3 for 53.
